prompt: Explain, by considering the units of the graph axes, why the area on a velocity-time graph has the unit of the metre.
hints: Multiply the unit of the vertical axis by the unit of the horizontal axis.
solution: The vertical axis has units of metres per second (m s^-1) and the horizontal axis has units of seconds (s). The area is their product: (m s^-1) x s = m, which is the metre.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: State the unit of velocity: m s^-1.
Step 2: State the unit of time: s.
Step 3: Multiply the units: m s^-1 x s = m.

mark_scheme.criterion: Shows unit multiplication: (m s^-1) x s = m and identifies this as the unit of displacement
